limitations.subtitle: Institutional disclosures, algorithm constraints, and recorded cryptographic checksums.
limitations.caveats_desc: Factors and quality disclosures recorded for this project:
limitations.method_limitations_desc: Methodology boundaries, optical constraints, and verification limits:
method_limitations: Satellite imagery can check observable claims such as planted area, planting and canopy change. It cannot check counterfactual baselines, so avoided-deforestation (REDD+) over-crediting claims are out of reach.
NDVI saturates in dense vegetation and is only a proxy for biomass or canopy.
NDVI thresholds were chosen, not calibrated against ground truth.
The area test depends on the natural forest allowance stated in the registry documents.
Quantile mapping assumes the reference ring behaves the same way from year to year.
Each year has only a few dry-season scenes, so uncertainty ranges reflect scene sampling only.
Catalog offset and baseline metadata can be unreliable, so the radiometric offset is detected from pixel values.
Hansen tree-cover loss is a 30 m indicator and includes plantation harvest; it is not a conclusion.
